start.title: [TODO:it] Be Watchful
start.text:
[TODO:it] Jesus says softly,
"The kingdom is like ten waiting for a bridegroom."

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Stay Awake
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] What he teaches now will guard your heart later.
Listen well.

wait.title: [TODO:it] Ten at the Gate
wait.text:
[TODO:it] Ten bridesmaids stand in the dusk,
lamps in hand, eyes on the road.

wander_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Hold Your Place
wander_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Those who wait well are the ones ready.
Stay with the lamps.

oil.title: [TODO:it] Extra Oil
oil.text:
[TODO:it] Some carry a small flask of extra oil.
Others carry only a lamp.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Fill a flask with extra oil

skip_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Be Prepared
skip_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] A wise heart plans for the long wait.
Fill the flask now.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Fill a flask with extra oil

borrow_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Your Own Flame
borrow_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Faith cannot be borrowed in the dark.
Carry your own oil.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Fill a flask with extra oil

delay.title: [TODO:it] The Long Wait
delay.text:
[TODO:it] Stars wheel overhead, the bridegroom delays.
Lamps flicker low.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:it] His Timing
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He comes in his own hour, not ours.
Keep the watch.

midnight.title: [TODO:it] Midnight Cry
midnight.text:
[TODO:it] A voice rings out at the dark hour,
"The bridegroom! Come out to meet him!"

sleep_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Rise Now
sleep_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The call has come. Do not miss it.
Lift your lamp.

run.title: [TODO:it] No Oil Left
run.text:
[TODO:it] Five lamps sputter and die in the dark.
They run to find oil in time.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Walk on with the wise five

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Be Humble
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Their loss is no joy to anyone.
Walk on with care.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Walk on with the wise five

door.title: [TODO:it] The Door Shuts
door.text:
[TODO:it] The bridegroom enters the feast.
The door swings closed behind him.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Stand in the warm light within

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Be Ready First
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The hour to prepare was before.
Readiness opens the door.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Stand in the warm light within
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You enter at the right time.

ending.title: [TODO:it] Keep Watch
ending.text:
[TODO:it] Jesus turns to you in the soft dawn.
"Watch, for you know not the hour."
